echoParts: For even the Son of Man
did not come to be served
verseText: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.
meaning: Jesus, the Son of Man, did not come so that others would serve him. He came to be our ransom: to pay the price to save us from sin.

recall.question: The “Son of Man” was a special name for Jesus. What did the Son of Man come to do?
choices: Serve others and give His life

meaning.question: A ransom is a price paid to set someone free. What did Jesus mean when He said He would give His life as a ransom?
choices: He would die to pay sin's price
He would pay for our sins with gold
He would pay the devil to set us free

application.prompt: Jesus deserved to be served like a king. But instead, he came to earth to serve and save sinners like us! His greatness is shown through His incredible love. How could you follow Jesus' example by putting someone else's needs before your own today?
